archetypes.name: sentinel-routing
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 routing now depends on terminal sentinel semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 prompt contract and loop handoff changes. Verify complete and cap-hit routing cannot advance from stale per-round env state. Check that recovery waiter wording and assertions pin the terminal sentinel without adding forbidden result-env polling literals. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: hook-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The hook allowlist is intentionally narrow and order-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new hook predicate at the full-command tier. Verify it allows only the exact .completed/step-3 waiter forms and still denies appended probes, compound tails, and .step3-review-result.env loops while a live marker is active. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: asset-drift
archetypes.rationale: The live plan-review path materializes an embedded retired shell asset.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the regenerated plan_review legacy asset and the parity assertion. Confirm the on-disk Step 3 loop source, embedded blob, and integration harness all exercise the stale-env clearing behavior that the runtime actually uses. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
